headline: The cut-off S305 wave is reconstructed and executable again: product work verified, four recovery defect classes closed, exact staging attested, and one real Obelisk registration gate left red instead of laundered green.

items.title: Interrupted S305 reconstructed without losing committed or uncommitted intent
items.insight: The prior session died after implementation and an interim brief, not after a real closeout. Recovery separated its landed product wave from one remaining verifier-window edit, validated every structured artifact, and removed only unreferenced scratch debris.
items.evidence: git log/diff ledger · JSON/NDJSON parse sweep · ~/.claude.json valid · no stale lock

items.title: A claimed green suite was rerun from step one and exposed two real defects
items.insight: News generation and speakable injection did not converge, then the all-page crawl collided with another Studio repo on port 4173. The generator now owns its final schema, and crawlers request an OS-assigned port reported by the preview server.

items.title: Deploy currency moved from an aged challenge to the actual Pages artifact
items.insight: The apex vantage had retained a 111-hour-old reading. The provider-owned origin returned the real answer immediately: production is 796 commits and 11.9 days behind with shell drift, so Doctor's blocker is actionable rather than mysterious.
items.evidence: api/deploy-currency.json · pages.dev live probe · Doctor blockingFailing 1

items.title: Exact recovery candidate deployed to canonical staging with chain depth 31
items.insight: The rollback-backed staging lane published 4,475 files and independently re-read its served receipt and ledger. Responsive, legal, and seven-theme browser checks are green after three stale contracts were brought back to current behavior.

items.title: A real Obelisk staging-registration defect blocked promotion safely
items.insight: Staging reaches the live authorization endpoint, but its exact callback is absent from this client's registry. The tenant boundary rejected it as designed; production stayed untouched and the owning session received a signed Ark request with negative controls.

honestyLedger.title: No phantom-green full browser suite
honestyLedger.why: The default 1,579-case multi-engine run timed out and is recorded as inconclusive; only direct completed receipts are green.

honestyLedger.title: No tenant-boundary bypass or production promotion
honestyLedger.why: The release gate found an auth-plane red owned by Obelisk; the website session sent signed cargo instead of editing the locked sibling or weakening validation.

honestyLedger.title: No stale-feed conflict choice
honestyLedger.why: Autostash conflicts were generated artifacts and were resolved by regenerating from the reconciled upstream tip, not by choosing either stale output.

blockers: Production content remains stale until the release gate is green

silDelta.note: The score reflects unfinished identity release, interrupted hygiene, and the original cross-repo violation; recovery quality is not used to erase those costs.
